name: Otto WP Stack
description: Standalone headless WordPress stack: own runtime, database, sites and registry — typed agent tools plus a token-authed local HTTP API for the Otto dashboard app.

stackRoot.description: Stack folder holding runtime/, db/, sites/, sites.json (Default: agent-workspace/wp-stack when a workspace exists, otherwise ~/otto-wp-stack).

dbUser.description: Stack-owned MariaDB user created by bin/wp-stack-bootstrap.sh (default wp_stack).

servePortMin.description: First HTTPS port wp_stack_serve may allocate for Tailscale Serve rules (default 8443).

servePortMax.description: Last HTTPS port wp_stack_serve may allocate (default 8499).

bindHost.description: Address site php servers bind to: 127.0.0.1 (default), tailnet (this Otto's Tailscale IPv4, reachable from tailnet devices) or a literal IPv4. wp_stack_expose binds exposed sites to the tailnet IP regardless; wp_stack_serve needs loopback.

apiToken.description: Bearer token for /otto-wp-stack/api. If unset, one is generated and written to .api-token in the plugin directory.
